result.summary: এই চুক্তিটি একটি মার্জার বা অধিগ্রহণ চুক্তি যা ফাইম প্রাইম থেরাপিউটিকস এবং প্যারেন্টের মধ্যে সম্পাদিত হয়েছে। চুক্তিতে বুদ্ধিবৃত্তিক সম্পত্তি, তথ্য সুরক্ষা এবং অন্যান্য বাণিজ্যিক শর্তাবলী অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে। তবে প্লেবুকের কিছু গুরুত্বপূর্ণ নীতি যেমন এআই প্রশিক্ষণ ডেটা বা আপটাইম এসএলএ এখানে সরাসরি উল্লেখ করা হয়নি।

redlines.originalText: any Company Contract (A) limiting the freedom or right of the Company, in any material respect, to engage in any line of business, drug discovery or development program, therapeutic area or geographic area or with respect to any class of compounds, molecules or products, or with any Person or to compete with any other Person in connection with any of the foregoing or to make use of any material Company IP, (B) containing any “most favored nations” terms and conditions (including with respect to pricing) granted by the Company or (C) containing exclusivity obligations or restrictions or otherwise materially limiting the freedom or right of the Company to research, develop, sell, distribute or manufacture any products or services or any technology or other assets to or for any other Person
redlines.proposedText: any Company Contract (A) limiting the freedom or right of the Company, in any material respect, to engage in any line of business, drug discovery or development program, therapeutic area or geographic area or with respect to any class of compounds, molecules or products, or with any Person or to compete with any other Person in connection with any of the foregoing or to make use of any material Company IP, provided that standard commercial non-solicitations and customary operational covenants shall not be restricted.
redlines.originalTextBn: এই ধারায় কোম্পানির ব্যবসা করার স্বাধীনতা, গবেষণা বা ভৌগোলিক সীমার ওপর একপক্ষীয়ভাবে কঠোর বিধিনিষেধ এবং এক্সক্লুসিভিটি আরোপ করা হয়েছে।
redlines.proposedTextBn: এই সংশোধনীতে সাধারণ বাণিজ্যিক সীমাবদ্ধতা বাদে অপ্রয়োজনীয় এক্সক্লুসিভিটি ও ব্যবসার ওপর অযৌক্তিক বাধাগুলো সীমিত করা হয়েছে।

chainOfThought.opposingCounselStance: The counterparty will argue that such restrictions are standard and necessary to protect proprietary business strategies and commercial exclusivity.
chainOfThought.commercialRiskAssessment: Unreasonable exclusivity and business restrictions severely limit our commercial flexibility and growth potential in adjacent therapeutic areas.
chainOfThought.legalRationale: Balancing restrictive covenants ensures compliance with antitrust laws and protects core operational freedom without compromising legitimate protections.
chainOfThought.negotiationTalkingPoint: We can accept standard operational restrictions if overly broad non-competes and blanket exclusivity clauses are removed. Fallback: Limit exclusivity scope to specific named compounds.

redlines.originalText: Parent shall ensure that each of its Subsidiaries (including Purchaser), and shall use reasonable best efforts to ensure that each of its Representatives, duly performs, satisfies and discharges on a timely basis each of the covenants, obligations and liabilities applicable to its Subsidiaries or its Representatives under this Agreement, and Parent, as applicable, shall be jointly and severally liable with its Subsidiaries and Representatives for the due and timely performance and satisfaction of each of said covenants, obligations and liabilities.
redlines.proposedText: Parent shall ensure that each of its Subsidiaries (including Purchaser) duly performs, satisfies and discharges on a timely basis each of the covenants, obligations and liabilities applicable under this Agreement, provided that Parent's liability shall be limited to performance assurance and shall not extend to direct operational liabilities except through designated primary recourse channels.
redlines.originalTextBn: এখানে প্যারেন্ট কোম্পানিকে সমস্ত সাবসিডিয়ারির দায়বদ্ধতার জন্য যৌথভাবে এবং এককভাবে (jointly and severally) দায়ী করা হয়েছে।
redlines.proposedTextBn: এই সংশোধনীতে প্যারেন্ট কোম্পানির দায়বদ্ধতাকে একটি যুক্তিসঙ্গত সীমার মধ্যে রাখা হয়েছে যাতে অতিরিক্ত আইনি ঝুঁকি তৈরি না হয়।

chainOfThought.opposingCounselStance: The counterparty will assert that joint and several liability is essential to ensure full accountability and recourse across corporate entities.
chainOfThought.commercialRiskAssessment: Blanket joint and several liability exposes the parent entity to disproportionate financial and legal risks for subsidiary operations.
chainOfThought.legalRationale: Limiting parent liability aligns with standard corporate structures while still offering adequate performance assurances to the buyer.
chainOfThought.negotiationTalkingPoint: We must protect the parent entity from unbounded exposure. Fallback: Retain joint and severally liability only for monetary payment obligations, excluding operational breaches.

redlines.originalText: To the Company’s Knowledge, since January 1, 2019, there have been no material unauthorized intrusions or other material security breaches, or material failures or breakdowns that have not been remedied in all material respects, with respect to the Company Systems
redlines.proposedText: To the Company’s Knowledge, since January 1, 2019, there have been no unauthorized intrusions or security breaches, or failures or breakdowns that have not been fully remedied, with respect to the Company Systems, and prompt notice shall be provided for any security incidents within 24 hours.
redlines.sectionTitleBn: ধারা ৭.৭ - ডেটা নিরাপত্তা ও সিস্টেম ব্রিচ
redlines.originalTextBn: নিরাপত্তা লঙ্ঘন বা ডেটা ব্রিচের ক্ষেত্রে কোম্পানির দায়বদ্ধতা কেবল 'ম্যাটেরিয়াল' বা বস্তুগত ব্যাতিক্রমের মধ্যে সীমাবদ্ধ রাখা হয়েছে।
redlines.proposedTextBn: এই সংশোধনীতে নিরাপত্তা ব্রিচ বা অননুমোদিত প্রবেশের ক্ষেত্রে কঠোর স্বচ্ছতা এবং দ্রুত নোটিফিকেশনের বাধ্যবাধকতা নিশ্চিত করা হয়েছে।

chainOfThought.opposingCounselStance: The counterparty will claim that materiality qualifiers are standard commercial practice to avoid frivolous claims over minor, non-impactful technical glitches.
chainOfThought.commercialRiskAssessment: Weak security covenants and vague materiality qualifiers expose customer data to unmitigated breach risks without clear notification duties.
chainOfThought.legalRationale: Enterprise SaaS standards require strict security covenants and rapid incident notification to comply with regulatory mandates.
chainOfThought.negotiationTalkingPoint: Security transparency is non-negotiable for enterprise deployments. Fallback: Allow a 48-hour notification window instead of 24 hours.

redlines.originalText: Upon such a holding, the Parties agree to negotiate in good faith to modify this Agreement so as to effect the original intent of the Parties as closely as possible in an acceptable manner
redlines.proposedText: Upon such a holding, the Parties agree to negotiate in good faith to modify this Agreement so as to effect the original intent, and if such good faith negotiations fail within thirty days, either party may terminate the affected provision without penalty.
redlines.originalTextBn: কোনো ধারা অবৈধ ঘোষিত হলে কেবল সদিচ্ছার সাথে পুনরায় আলোচনার কথা বলা হয়েছে, যা সুনির্দিষ্ট প্রতিকার নিশ্চিত করে না।
redlines.proposedTextBn: এই সংশোধনীতে আলোচনার সময়সীমা এবং সুনির্দিষ্ট প্রতিকার বা চুক্তি বাতিলের অধিকার যুক্ত করা হয়েছে।

chainOfThought.opposingCounselStance: The counterparty will maintain that a good faith negotiation clause is a fair and standard mechanism to preserve the core commercial intent of the agreement.
chainOfThought.commercialRiskAssessment: An open-ended good faith negotiation clause without an exit mechanism leaves parties stuck in endless deadlocks if a core clause becomes illegal.
chainOfThought.legalRationale: Adding a definitive timeframe and termination fallback ensures contractual certainty if severance disrupts the commercial balance.
chainOfThought.negotiationTalkingPoint: We need a clear resolution mechanism if negotiations stall. Fallback: Extend the negotiation period to 45 days before an exit right triggers.

missingProtections.title: Renewal with Reminder and Short Opt-Out Notice
missingProtections.standardText: This Agreement renews for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the current term. The Provider shall send a written renewal reminder, including any price change, at least sixty (60) days before each renewal date. Renewal fees may not increase by more than the lower of five percent (5%) or the applicable consumer price index.
missingProtections.evidence: এই চুক্তিটি একটি নির্ধারিত মার্জার বা অধিগ্রহণ চুক্তি (Merger Agreement), তাই স্বাভাবিক রিনিউয়াল বা নবায়ন সংক্রান্ত বিধান এখানে প্রযোজ্য নয়।

opposingFindings.leverage: The counterparty will claim that materiality qualifiers are standard commercial practice to avoid frivolous claims over minor, non-impactful technical glitches.

opposingFindings.quote: Upon such a holding, the Parties agree to negotiate in good faith to modify this Agreement so as to effect the original intent
opposingFindings.issue: কোনো ধারা অবৈধ ঘোষিত হলে কেবল সদিচ্ছার সাথে পুনরায় আলোচনার কথা বলা হয়েছে, যা সুনির্দিষ্ট প্রতিকার বা স্বয়ংক্রিয় রিফান্ড নিশ্চিত করে না।
opposingFindings.leverage: The counterparty will maintain that a good faith negotiation clause is a fair and standard mechanism to preserve the core commercial intent of the agreement.
